title: The Lantern Projection
description: A woman in a dark Victorian dress with a red cape stands in a decaying ornate room, operating a vintage magic lantern projector. The projector casts a bright beam of light onto a crumbling wall, displaying a projected image of a woman in a red cape reaching toward her own shadow silhouette.
prompt: A woman wearing a dark Victorian dress and flowing red cape stands in profile operating an antique brass magic lantern projector in a dilapidated baroque room with cracked walls and overgrown vines. The projector emits a strong golden beam of light that illuminates a large projected image on the decaying wall showing a woman in a red cape reaching toward her own dark silhouette shadow. Film reels and equipment are scattered on the table, dramatic volumetric lighting, cinematic composition, highly detailed digital painting.
